name: Hubertusheim
beschreibung: Hubertusheim in Ischgl offers well-equipped, self-catering holiday apartments in a quiet location close to the town center. Designed in traditional Tyrolean style, the residence is only a short walk from the Silvretta cable car and local amenities. Each apartment features a fully appointed kitchen, comfortable living and sleeping areas, and a private balcony overlooking the alpine scenery. A heated ski storage room with boot warmers and on-site parking add convenience. In winter, winter sports fans enjoy seamless access to the world-class Silvretta Arena, while summer guests explore panoramic hiking trails throughout the Paznaun Valley.
kurzbeschreibung: Comfortable holiday apartments in Ischgl in the Paznaun Valley within easy walking distance of the Silvretta cable car.
